description: The plot titled “Training Loss of 20M Data Size” illustrates training loss trajectories over training steps for six model configurations at a 20M data size. The x-axis is labeled “Step” on a linear scale and is shown with a broken axis: the left segment spans from 0k to 80k with tick labels at 0k, 20k, 40k, 60k, and 80k, and the right segment spans from 420k to 440k with tick labels at 420k, 430k, and 440k. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss” on a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.85, with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. All six series are drawn as thin solid lines without markers: ChemBART Small 20M (red) starts near ~0.8 at the earliest steps, drops steeply within the first few thousand steps, then gradually declines to around ~0.10 by ~80k, and appears around ~0.04–0.05 in the 420k–440k segment with slight fluctuations; ChemBART Medium 20M (blue) follows a similar shape, decreasing from near ~0.8 early to roughly ~0.09–0.10 by ~80k and sitting around ~0.03–0.04 between 420k and 440k; ChemBERTa Small 20M (green) begins near ~0.8, declines rapidly early, then trends downward more gradually to about ~0.11–0.12 by ~80k and is around ~0.05–0.06 in the 420k–440k window; ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange) decreases from near ~0.8 at the start to roughly ~0.09–0.10 by ~80k and is around ~0.04–0.05 from 420k to 440k; ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple) drops from near ~0.8 early to about ~0.07–0.08 by ~80k and is around ~0.03–0.04 in the 420k–440k segment; ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown) similarly falls from near ~0.8 at the beginning to roughly ~0.06–0.07 by ~80k and appears around ~0.02–0.03 between 420k and 440k, with small step-to-step noise visible across all curves.
